summary: Offline-only PR83 candidate for observed relay roots A-F; no real ChatGPT send, browser click, GitHub mailbox polling, credentials or network actions were executed here. A: relay_fixes.bubble_match and chatgpt_page_io.PAGE_STATE use one turn-bound complete DOM message subtree stripped of UI controls, no substring/trailing Show more trimming; positive exact readback can reconcile a folded message without resending. B: tracker detects pending cards and calls the existing scoped allow-once approver exactly once after CONFIRMED; relay_fixes.card_guard rejects secrets, permission expansion, out-of-scope paths and other repository references; chatgpt_card_approver persists product_dispatch.APPROVE_INTENT before a single click, requires card disappearance readback and never retries unknown acknowledgements. C: product_dispatch.release_revise still requires SENT_CONFIRMED and now rechecks its original positive send receipt SHA and pending card intent, preserving generation/verdict binding; SEND_UNKNOWN remains blocked until positive reconcile, never treated as sufficient. D: worker-state.json contains instruction/phase/since; phases WAIT_LOGIN/SENT/CARD_PENDING/CARD_APPROVED/HANDBACK/EXPIRED and CARD_REFUSED are visible, with durable card-intent and no second click across restarts. E: make_job CLI builds an explicit repo/branch/PR/chat/allowlist/expiry job.json in a new directory without inferring chat and refusing overwrite. F: synthetic drill exercises folded full-message send evidence, single card scoped gate, handback and new instruction phase plus refusal/no-resend controls; these do not constitute browser-based proof. Exact previous seed guard on send intent remains; product_dispatch release still generation/verdict-bound. WARNING: source candidate NOT executed: main runtime, Node/CDP DOM compatibility, installed approval journal semantics, and tracker click/readback remain to be verified independently. One known gap: drill uses synthetic state progression rather than executing the complete tracker with a fake subprocess transport. No claim of full production acceptance.
